description: Add an external layer (WMS/WMTS/XYZ/GeoJSON) to the map for the current session.

descriptionFull.title: An 'Add layer from URL' form in a floating panel over the map. It starts hidden — reveal it with the core action 'plugins:show:AddTempLayerTool'; its close button hides it again. Added layers are session-only and lost on reload.

name: AddTempLayer
